messages.snippet: Helen, Further to our call, please find our first draft of the standstill and forbearance agreement.
messages.subject: Project Harbor - draft standstill
messages.plaintextBody:
Helen,

Further to our call, please find our first draft of the standstill and forbearance agreement. Key points from our side: a standstill period to 19 December, default interest capitalised rather than cash-pay, and the £75k standstill fee capitalised. We've reflected the agreed reporting (13-week cashflow weekly, IBR by 21 November).

Grateful for Pennine's turn.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - draft standstill
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Broadly fine. Credit are comfortable with the period and the capitalised fee. Two points: (1) we want the standstill to fall away automatically if any other creditor takes enforcement action; and (2) confirm there'll be no payments to the family holdco during the period. If you can land those we can sign Friday.

Helen Marsh | Director, Restructuring & Recoveries | Pennine Business Bank plc
